how_to_verify: COPY THE CUE: each REAL-lane row is the exact cue the watch sealed — window, BUY side, model %, ask, stake. Your tap should match it.
CHECK THE RESULT: each row names its outcome (WIN or LOSS) and the sealed source that settled it, with the ledger sequence number — anyone can pull the same record.
CHECK THE MATH: the play-along bank starts at $5.00 and every row shows stake, win/loss, P&L and the bank after. Add it up yourself — it must foot to the final bank.
CALL OUT AN ERROR: if a tap does not match its cue, or a result does not match its source, that is a human error — the record here is the referee.
